description:
Per-field source-tagged committed value on WizardCommitState_v0.

Structural invariant (enforced at construction time):
  exactly one of `operator_turn_ref` / `agent_assumption_id` is set;
  the other is None. Never both, never neither.

The `source` field mirrors that split:
  * `operator_supplied` → operator_turn_ref set, agent_assumption_id None
  * `agent_assumed`     → agent_assumption_id set, operator_turn_ref None

value.description: Loose-as-frozen; type narrows at v1 post-G2b.
value.title: Value

source.description: Anti-laundering seam per Owner E3 ruling; MUST be consistent with the XOR ref pair below.
source.title: Source

operator_turn_ref.description: uuid pointing to a WizardCommitState_v0.turns[] entry. Set iff source='operator_supplied'.
operator_turn_ref.title: Operator Turn Ref

agent_assumption_id.description: uuid pointing to a WizardCommitState_v0.agent_assumptions[] entry. Set iff source='agent_assumed'.
agent_assumption_id.title: Agent Assumption Id

title: CommittedValue_v0
